title: Memory: skip markdown placeholder snippets during short-term promotion
suggested_fix: 在 short-term promotion 路径新增 isMarkdownPlaceholderLine / isPlaceholderShortTermSnippet，与现有 isContaminatedDreamingSnippet 合并为 isUnpromotableShortTermSnippet，并在 recordShortTermRecalls、recordGroundedShortTermCandidates、rank/apply 与 substring relocation 入口统一过滤 bare `-` 等 markdown 占位符。
risk: issue 带 stale 标签但无阻塞标签；需确认 substring relocation 收紧后不会误伤合法短 snippet。无 open PR，但 memory promotion 行为变更需回归 dreaming/grounded 相邻测试。
